providers.name: claude
providers.description: Claude models through the Anthropic API

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Your key from the Claude Console. Used ahead of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; left empty, that or ant auth login is used.

settings.label: Show my balance
settings.help: While a @claude model is in use, your API balance shows under the message box. Needs an Admin API key.

settings.label: Admin API key
settings.help: Only for the balance: Claude Console, Settings, Admin keys. Reads what your organization has spent, nothing else. ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY if empty.

settings.label: Balance ($)
settings.help: The credit you had on the day below, so Flash can say what is left. Left at 0, it shows this month's spending instead.

settings.label: Balance as of
settings.help: The day that balance was right, like 2026-11-01.
